title: Ancient Egypt and the Pharaohs
text: Ancient Egypt was a civilization of ancient Northeast Africa, concentrated along the Nile River. It thrived for over three millennia, from around 3100 BCE (unification under Pharaoh Menes) to 30 BCE (Roman conquest). Ancient Egyptians built some of history's most iconic monuments, including the Great Pyramid of Giza, constructed around 2560 BCE for Pharaoh Khufu, and the Sphinx. Egyptian society was organized around the pharaoh, who was considered a god-king. Hieroglyphics, one of the world's earliest writing systems, preserved religious texts, historical records, and literary works. The Rosetta Stone, discovered in 1799, enabled scholars to decipher hieroglyphics.
